text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
I answered Hollis in a reply to his message in #central-random: the ticket is #88412.

Tobias posted it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025. It was the Tier 2 escalation for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 freezing on the BOL barcode scan. He also confirmed the account was Tansleigh Packaging (TSP), not Tansley Parcel. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so he can see that thread himself.

I also told him that the Central weekly for Jul 13, 2026 uses PD-88412 for an unrelated Marrow Fieldworks issue. I suggested he put the account code next to the number in the tracker so the two don't get mixed up.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply? Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I answered Tobias in a reply to his message in #central-random: the ticket is PD-4821.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on Jun 9, 2026. He said PD-4821 has the Eastbank receiving-door import attached, and that the file labels doors E1/E2 while Marrow Agrisupply's booking sheet uses 01/02. Tobias is a member of #central-team, so he can see that message himself.

I also told him that the Central weekly for Oct 20, 2025 uses CS-4821 for a different Marrow Agrisupply door mix-up. I suggested he keep the PD- prefix in his notes so the two don't get confused.
